records.title: CommitKV: Lifecycle-Aware KV Cache Compression via Commit Transitions for Multi-Turn Agents
records.reason: Commit-aware KV-cache compression addresses multi-turn agent inference memory and latency while preserving accuracy.

records.title: A Survey on Memory-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Large Language Models
records.reason: The ACL Anthology publisher abstract is verified, but it focuses on fine-tuning memory efficiency and does not establish inference/serving efficiency; retain as borderline for adjacent system methods.

records.title: QoS-Efficient Serving of Multiple Mixture-of-Expert LLMs Using Partial Runtime Reconfiguration
records.reason: Partial runtime reconfiguration schedules several MoE LLMs for QoS-efficient serving.

records.title: XY-Serve: End-to-End Versatile Production Serving for Dynamic LLM Workloads
records.reason: The ACM Digital Library direct page returned HTTP 403; a non-publisher author/organization abstract was found, but the required publisher-hosted abstract was unavailable.

records.title: EC-RAG: Towards Efficient Edge-Cloud Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems
records.reason: IEEE’s publisher abstract describes edge-cloud RAG routing, dynamic chunk pruning, and edge SLM inference optimization to balance quality, cost, and latency.

records.title: Eliminating Hidden Serialization in Multi-Node Megakernel Communication
records.reason: The primary abstract explicitly targets multi-node MoE inference and removes communication serialization, with reported end-to-end speedups.

records.title: A Survey: Collaborative Hardware and Software Design in the Era of Large Language Models
records.reason: The survey is broad but specifically covers LLM hardware/software co-design, deployment resource demands, and system-level efficiency.

records.title: Streaming Kernel PCA Algorithm With Small Space
records.reason: The primary abstract is exclusively a low-space streaming Kernel PCA algorithm; it does not concern LLM inference, serving, or model inference efficiency.

records.title: OSCAR: Offline Spectral Covariance-Aware Rotation for 2-bit KV Cache Quantization
records.reason: The paper introduces 2-bit KV-cache quantization and deployable attention kernels, reporting memory, throughput, and decoding gains for LLM serving.

records.title: Agent-X: Full Pipeline Acceleration of On-device AI Agents
records.reason: Agent-X accelerates on-device agent prefill through prefix caching and decoding through speculative generation.

records.title: P/D-Device: Disaggregated Large Language Model between Cloud and Devices
records.reason: P/D-Device coordinates cloud and device inference to reduce TTFT and cloud occupancy while increasing serving throughput.

records.title: Mugi: Value Level Parallelism For Efficient LLMs
records.reason: Mugi co-designs value-level parallelism, quantization and KV-cache operations for more efficient LLM workloads.

records.title: Sparse Attention as a Range Searching Problem: Towards an Inference-Efficient Index for KV Cache
records.reason: Louver is an inference-oriented, hardware-aware KV-cache index for sparse attention with recall guarantees and runtime benefits.

records.title: SuperSpec: Enhanced Verification and Sampling for End-to-End LLM Speculative Decoding
records.reason: The IEEE publisher abstract was unavailable in the direct retrieval path; the DOI/title are identified, but no primary abstract was accessible.

records.title: It Takes Two: Embracing Sparsity and Speculative Decoding for Efficient LLM Inference
records.reason: IEEE Xplore returned a JavaScript/robot challenge for the DOI page; an abstract could not be verified from a publisher-hosted source.

records.title: Accelerating attention through gradient-based learned runtime pruning
records.reason: Learned attention pruning and bit-serial early termination target transformer-language-model inference speed and energy.

records.title: Towards LifeSpan Cognitive Systems
records.reason: The primary abstract discusses long-term experience storage and response generation but presents a conceptual system without a concrete inference-efficiency mechanism; retain as borderline.

records.title: Arrow: Adaptive Scheduling Mechanisms for Disaggregated LLM Inference Architecture
records.reason: Arrow adaptively schedules prefill/decode instances in a disaggregated LLM-serving system and reports higher request-serving rates.

records.title: BATQuant: Outlier-resilient MXFP4 Quantization via Learnable Block-wise Optimization
records.reason: BATQuant is post-training low-bit quantization for LLM/MLLM deployment on accelerator hardware, preserving accuracy under constrained precision.

records.title: Value-Aware Stochastic KV Cache Eviction for Reasoning Models
records.reason: VaSE compresses reasoning-model KV caches with value-aware stochastic eviction and supports a static serving memory footprint.
